learning_objective: 🎯 Learn awesome yoga poses to build super strength, amazing flexibility, and a calm, focused mind for all your daily adventures!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Taking deep, slow breaths fills your brain with oxygen! It helps you calm down before a big test and gives you energy to play all day.
Practicing Tadasana teaches you to stand super straight with your shoulders back. Good posture keeps your spine healthy and makes you look confident!
Stretching your muscles like a rubber band prevents injuries when you play sports. It makes your body feel light, happy, and ready to move!

fun_activity.title: 🌳 The Strong Tree Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Stand on one leg, place your other foot on your inner thigh, and reach your arms up like branches. See who can balance the longest without wobbling!

quick_recap: ⭐ Deep breathing is your secret superpower to control anger and stay completely relaxed.
⭐ Standing tall like a mountain protects your back and makes your core super strong.
⭐ Do some gentle stretches every morning to wake up your body and start the day right!
